title.zh: 停复机实例开关机状态查询接口
title.en: API for Querying Power State of Power Control Instances

descriptions.zh:
**本接口只能针对数字人停复机实例状态进行查询操作，非停复机实例无法操作。**
调用该接口将返回当前停复机实例的开关机状态，具体状态值对应下方的系统返回参数部分。

><warning>该接口调用轮询周期建议3s一次，不可低于1s一次，否则可能会导致触发限流。></warning>
descriptions.en:
**This operation can only query the status of digital human instances that support start and stop operations. It does not apply to other instance types.**
This operation returns the current power status of the instance. For details about the status values, see the response parameters section.

><warning>

Set the polling interval to 3 seconds. Do not set the interval to less than 1 second. A shorter interval may trigger rate limiting.

></warning>
